import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, mix, vec3 } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry } = ctx.THREE;
  const container = new Group();

  // 1. Stage Backdrop (Vertical Gradient Surface to Ink to prevent FLAT_VOID)
  const stageGeom = new PlaneGeometry(8, 6);
  const stageMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ depthWrite: false });
  stageMat.colorNode = mix(vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063), vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114), uv().y);
  
  const stageMesh = new Mesh(stageGeom, stageMat);
  stageMesh.position.z = -1.0;
  container.add(stageMesh);

  // 2. Primary Sprite Card (Atlas Aspect Ratio 512x320 = 1.6)
  const cardWidth = 3.2;
  const cardHeight = 2.0;
  const cardGeom = new PlaneGeometry(cardWidth, cardHeight);
  const cardMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.95
  });

  // Base backdrop color mixed with signal-red accent line on bottom edge
  const baseGrad = mix(vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063), vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114), uv().y);
  const accentRed = vec3(1.0, 0.165, 0.22); // #ff2a38
  const bottomLine = uv().y.lessThan(0.02);
  cardMat.colorNode = mix(baseGrad, accentRed, bottomLine);

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeom, cardMat);
  container.add(cardMesh);

  // Load subtle grain texture
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl || '/prism-assets/chrome/ceramic-grain.map.png';
  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((tex) => {
    cardMat.map = tex;
    cardMat.needsUpdate = true;
  }).catch(() => {});

  // 3. Text Render using ctx.fontAtlas
  const items = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const headlineItem = items.find(item => item.role === 'headline') || { text: 'Features' };

  const titleText = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(headlineItem.text, {
    fontSize: 54,
    color: '#e8ecf2',
    align: 'center'
  });
  // Position text slightly in front of the textured plane
  titleText.position.set(0, -0.05, 0.05);
  container.add(titleText);

  // 4. Motion / Animation
  // Weighted-settle entrance animation
  container.position.y += 0.3;
  container.scale.set(0.95, 0.95, 0.95);

  const tl = gsap.timeline();
  tl.to(container.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 0.9,
    ease: 'power4.out'
  });
  tl.to(container.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 0.9,
    ease: 'power4.out'
  }, '<');

  // Idle movement cycle (one slow transform)
  const idleTl = gsap.timeline({ repeat: -1, yoyo: true });
  idleTl.to(cardMesh.position, {
    y: 0.03,
    duration: 3.5,
    ease: 'sine.inOut'
  });

  // 5. Cinematic Primitives application
  const primitiveCleanups = [];
  if (config.cinematicPrimitives) {
    config.cinematicPrimitives.forEach((prim) => {
      if (ctx.primitives && ctx.primitives[prim.name]) {
        const res = ctx.primitives[prim.name](container, prim.params);
        if (res && typeof res.cleanup === 'function') {
          primitiveCleanups.push(res.cleanup);
        }
      }
    });
  }

  // 6. Explicit Cleanups matching technical checklist requirements
  container.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup: () => {
      // Kill GSAP timelines
      tl.kill();
      idleTl.kill();

      // Clean up primitive bindings
      primitiveCleanups.forEach(cb => {
        if (typeof cb === 'function') cb();
      });

      // Dispose geometries & materials
      stageGeom.dispose();
      stageMat.dispose();
      cardGeom.dispose();
      cardMat.dispose();
    }
  };

  return container;
}
